claims: Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer are fraternal twins.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer are 2026 Duke basketball freshmen.
Carlos Boozer is the father of Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer.
Carlos Boozer is a two-time NBA All-Star.
Duke is Carlos Boozer's alma mater.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer are five-star recruits from Miami.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer led Columbus High to four state titles.
Cayden Boozer is a point guard.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer are the sons of Carlos Boozer and CeCe Boozer.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer were born via IVF.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer were born to serve as a bone marrow and stem cell match for their older brother Carmani.
Carmani was born with sickle cell anemia.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer committed to Duke in October 2024.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer chose Duke over Miami and Florida.
Carlos Boozer wore the same jersey in 2001 as his sons wear at Duke.
